# HEP Journals

> > A comprehensive open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed multidisciplinary research journals with advanced discovery and submission tools.

HEP Journals is operated by Higher Education Press and provides a centralized platform for open-access research publishing across multiple disciplines including physics, engineering, agriculture, computer science, and medicine. The platform emphasizes peer review standards, Creative Commons licensing, and international editorial guidelines.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- peer-reviewed journals
- multidisciplinary research

## Core Platform & Discovery

- [HEP Journals Homepage](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/home): Main entry point showcasing multidisciplinary open-access academic journals
- [Platform Home](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN): HEP Journals platform for peer-reviewed multidisciplinary research
- [Latest Articles](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/latestArticle): Latest published articles across HEP Journals portfolio
- [Advanced Search](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/advsearch): Advanced search interface for discovering articles across journals
- [Figure & Table Search](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/figure_result): Figure and table search functionality for research article discovery
- [Top Read Articles](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/top_social): Top read articles with Mendeley citation metrics and management tools
- [Research Collections](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/collections): Curated research collections including Chinese Academy of Engineering

## Featured Journals

- [Frontiers of Physics](https://journal.hep.com.cn/fop): Peer-reviewed journal for quantum and condensed-matter research
- [ENGINEERING Agriculture](https://journal.hep.com.cn/fase): Open-access agricultural research journal

## Author Resources & Guidelines

- [Manuscript Submission](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/submission): Manuscript submission guidelines and instructions for authors
- [Editorial Policy](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/policy): Editorial policy, publication guidelines and ICMJE/COPE standards
- [Open Access Information](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/open_access): Open-access publishing information with Creative Commons licensing

## Subscription & Access

- [Journal Subscription](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/subscription): Journal subscription information and postal codes for HEP publications

## About & Resources

- [About HEP Journals](https://journal.hep.com.cn/hep/EN/us): About Higher Education Press and HEP Journals corporate information
